product_metadata.title: 3 Piece Christmas Silicone Spatula Gift Set with lovely bow and gift card. Easy clean, durable, high temperature and stain resistant. Bamboo handles. Great for Christmas decorating, gifts and baking.
features: ADD A FUN AND CHEERFUL TOUCH to you and your friends' kitchen during the holidays.

MAKES A GREAT GIFT for Secret Santa, office parties, hostess gifts, stocking stuffers, and for anyone who cooks! Think of all those last minute "under $20" gifts for teachers, postman, lawn guy, child care, etc!

EXCELLENT QUALITY THAT WON’T MELT OR FADE - Easy clean, non-stick, food grade silicone with bamboo handles. Heat resistant to 450 F. Stain, fade and odor resistant. These sturdy 2"x 3" heads have slightly flexible tips to get into corners, so they're great for baking, yet hold up wonderfully for heavy duty work too, like stewing, saucing, and sauteing up to 450 F. The print is professionally formed into the silicone head itself, so it won't rub off. You'll enjoy them for years to come.

WHAT’S INCLUDED? This fun set includes three 12" spatulas with 3 fun quotes, a 3" butterfly bow (comes flat and just pull end strings to fluff) and a lovely full color photo gift card. You just add the love.

PUT A SMILE ON EVERYONE’S FACE. Get creative and split them up to use as gift decorations or along with a baked goody like cookies or fudge and delight your friends. After all, who isn’t a “cookie monster” this time of year? These spats are sure to make them smile and chuckle.
description: This silicone gift set includes three 12" silicone spatulas with bamboo handles, a gift bow and a gift card. They make a wonderful "under $20" fun Christmas gift for guys or gals. They're made of tough and durable, non-stick food grade silicone with bamboo handles, so they're fun yet practical for anyone who cooks. You can also split the set up, using them as stocking stuffers, part of a package decoration, include one with some other kitchen item, or make it a gift with one of your own favorite recipes! Best of all, they're perfect for decorating your own kitchen. They add a little festive fun to baking and cooking projects.
